item.title: Market Sell-Off Over MSCI Report Is Temporary, Finance Minister Says
item.description: Jakarta. Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said on Wednesday that the sharp sell-off on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) following a report by MSCI Inc reflected an excessive market reaction to what he described as a preliminary assessment. item.title: Bio Farma to Let Go of Kimia Farma, Danantara Says
item.description: Jakarta. Sovereign wealth fund Danantara wants the state-run vaccine manufacturer Bio Farma to let go of its pharmaceutical subsidiary Kimia Farma amid ambitious business overhauls. Restructuring Indonesia’s state-run enterprises has been on top of Danantara’s to-do list, and the health sector will go under the knife sooner or later. item.title: JCI Extends Losses on Thursday Post MSCI Index Freeze Announcement
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesia’s benchmark Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) slid sharply on Thursday morning as markets reacted to MSCI’s decision to freeze key index adjustments for Indonesian stocks. The JCI opened at 8,027 and slid 293 points, or 3.65%, moving within an intraday range of 7,884 to 8,049 in early trading. item.title: Breaking: JCI Tumbles 8% in First 30 Minutes on Thursday, Trading Halted
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesia’s stock exchange halted trading on Thursday morning after the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) plunged more than 8% within the first 30 minutes of the session, triggering an automatic circuit breaker through the Jakarta Automated Trading System (JATS). The benchmark index shed 665 points, or 8%, to hit an intraday low of 7,654, moving within a range of 7,654 to 8,049 before the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) imposed a 30-minute trading halt. item.title: Russia and Ukraine's Combined War Casualties Could Reach 2 Million Soon, Report Estimates
item.description: Kyiv. The number of soldiers killed, injured, or missing on both sides of Russia's war on Ukraine could be 2 million by spring, with Russia sustaining the largest number of troop deaths for any major power in any conflict since World War II, a report warned Tuesday. item.title: Antam Gold Hits New All-Time High at Rp 3.16 Mill per Gram as Global Prices Rally
item.description: Jakarta. Gold prices in Indonesia surged to fresh record highs on Thursday, tracking a powerful rally in global bullion markets as investors flocked to safe-haven assets amid geopolitical tensions and mounting global economic uncertainty. Antam’s gold bar price jumped Rp 165,000 on Thursday to Rp 3,168,000 ($188.67) per gram, setting a new all-time high. item.description: Jakarta. item.title: UBS, Goldman Cut Indonesia Equity Calls After MSCI Warning
item.description: Jakarta. Global investment banks UBS and Goldman Sachs have cut their recommendations on Indonesian equities after MSCI warned about market transparency issues in Indonesia’s capital market, raising the risk of a downgrade from emerging market to frontier market status and potential large capital outflows. item.title: JCI Slumps Nearly 6% After Trading Halt, Touched 10% Intraday
item.description: Jakarta. Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) ended the first session of intraday trading sharply lower on Thursday, closing at 7,828, down 492 points or 5.91%, after trading was briefly halted earlier in the session when losses deepened to as much as 10%. The index moved within a 7,481–8,049 range during the session.
